rules.prepare:
export PKG_CONFIG="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config"
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" bh_autotools_dev_update
# The configure script of the release is used as it is: Debian's only patch # is not applied, see package.xml. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --sysconfdir=/etc \ --disable-silent-rules \ --with-trust-paths=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt \ --with-hash-impl=internal \ --without-bash-completion \ --disable-nls \ --disable-doc
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
cd "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" find . -name "*.la" -exec rm '{}' ';'
# An example of the configuration, and the script that Debian has among the # examples of the documentation. rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/etc/pkcs11/pkcs11.conf.example" rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/libexec/p11-kit/trust-extract-compat"
